platform.tagline: Assessment and interactive reports for Microsoft 365 tenants.

auth.stubNotice: Entra SSO needs App Registration credentials in .env for live Microsoft login.

tenant.connectHint: Connect a Mandant on the Tenants page.

tenants.title: Connect tenants
tenants.body: Register a Microsoft 365 Mandant for this organization via admin consent. Each tenant only sees and evaluates its own data.
tenants.emptyBody: Use Microsoft admin consent when Entra is configured, or the clearly labeled demo path to simulate a tenant for UI preview.
tenants.connectRealBody: Starts Entra admin consent for the multi-tenant app (assessment-first Graph read scopes). On return we create or update the TenantLink for your organization.
tenants.connectRealDisabled: Set AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_ID and AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_SECRET, and register redirect URI /api/tenants/consent/callback, to enable real consent on this host.
tenants.connectDemoBody: Demo only — no Microsoft call. Creates a mock TenantLink for this organization so you can exercise the UI.
tenants.scopesBody: Real admin consent grants the Graph permissions configured on the App Registration. This portal requests read scopes for Conditional Access inventory — not write/deploy.

flash.already_connected: This Mandant was already connected for your organization.

errors.consent_denied: Admin consent was denied or failed.
errors.consent_incomplete: Consent callback was incomplete (missing tenant or admin_consent).
errors.invalid_state: Consent state was invalid or expired. Start again from Connect tenant.
errors.entra_not_configured: Entra credentials are not configured on this host.
